annotations.title: Edit an image with a sentence

description: Changes one finished image with a short instruction, e.g. "warmer light, add a marble counter" or "make the headline say Leak-proof". Keeps the product and everything else the same. The result is a new version; the old one stays. Costs the same credits as one image (usually 1); explicit, hateful or misleading changes are refused at no cost. Then call get_image_set.

instruction.description: What to change, in one or two sentences
